name: Engineering Chemistry
description: Electrochemistry, polymers, water technology, corrosion engineering, and fuels.

questions.prompt: In cathodic protection via sacrificial anode, what metal is commonly connected to steel underground pipelines to prevent rusting?
questions.explanation: Zinc and magnesium have more negative reduction potentials than iron/steel, oxidizing preferentially as sacrificial anodes.

questions.prompt: What unit operation removes dissolved salts from seawater using a semipermeable membrane under high pressure?
questions.explanation: Reverse osmosis applies mechanical pressure higher than the natural osmotic pressure to force pure water through a semipermeable membrane.
